topStories.headline: US Markets Cap Strongest First Half Since 2021; Chip Rally Adds $2T in Q2
topStories.summary: All three major US indices closed higher June 30 to seal H1 gains — S&P 500 +9.6%, Nasdaq +12.8%, Dow +8.9% — paced by a chip and AI rally that added $2 trillion in combined market cap to Micron, Intel, and AMD in Q2 alone, with the Russell 2000 surging 22% for its best H1 since 1991.
topStories.marketImpact: Equities ↑ broadly; MU, INTC, AMD ↑; Asia markets follow with Nikkei +1.79% and Kospi +1.52% on July 1

topStories.headline: Japan Tankan Hits 6-Year High on AI Demand; Yen Near 40-Year Low
topStories.summary: Japan's Q2 Tankan large manufacturer index jumped to 22 from 17 (vs 16 expected) — its highest reading since 2020 — and the non-manufacturing index hit a multi-decade high of 37, while the yen slid further to ~161.79 per dollar despite the Bank of Japan raising rates to 1% in June.
topStories.marketImpact: Nikkei ↑ 1.79% on July 1; export stocks ↑ on weak yen; BOJ FX intervention risk elevated; EWJ ↑; USD/JPY ↑ watch

topStories.headline: Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump's Birthright Citizenship Order in 5-4 Ruling
topStories.summary: Chief Justice Roberts and Justice Barrett joined the three liberal justices to block Trump's executive order restricting birthright citizenship, handing his immigration agenda a major defeat; Trump called the ruling 'too bad for our Country' and urged Congress to act.
topStories.marketImpact: Limited direct market impact; DJT ↓ on political setback; construction and hospitality labour supply risk watch

topStories.headline: Trump 2025 Financial Disclosures Reveal More Than $1.4 Billion in Crypto Earnings
topStories.summary: Trump's annual OGE filing shows $635M from TRUMP meme coin sales, $500M+ from World Liberty Financial, and $80M+ in media settlements, intensifying conflict-of-interest scrutiny as his policies directly benefit his own digital asset holdings.
topStories.marketImpact: Crypto broadly ↑ (COIN, MSTR, BTC); DJT mixed — Trump Media posted a $405M crypto-related loss, partly offsetting the headline crypto gains

topStories.headline: US-Iran Ceasefire Fragile; Both Sides Agree to Halt Attacks and Resume Talks
topStories.summary: After the US struck Iranian missile storage and drone sites on June 26 over ceasefire violations in the Strait of Hormuz, both parties agreed to halt hostilities and renew negotiations, though shipping companies remain wary of Hormuz transit due to elevated war-risk insurance and lingering sea mines.
topStories.marketImpact: Oil ↑ watch on supply risk; Brent ~$72 (well below $188 wartime peak); XOM, CVX ↑; shipping stocks ↓ risk on elevated war-risk insurance; gold ↑ as safe haven

topStories.headline: Section 122 Tariff Authority Expires July 24 — Congress Must Act or Trade Policy Lapses
topStories.summary: Trump's 10% global tariffs imposed under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 hit their 150-day statutory maximum on July 24, requiring congressional approval to extend and creating significant policy uncertainty as businesses rush shipments and importers reassess supply chains.
topStories.marketImpact: Importers and retailers (WMT, TGT, AMZN) ↓ watch on re-escalation risk; trade-sensitive industrials (XLI) ↓ risk; USD uncertain on policy vacuum

companiesToWatch.name: Micron Technology
companiesToWatch.reason: Led the chip/AI rally that defined Q2 2026, adding $2T in combined market cap with INTC and AMD; AI memory demand and pricing cycle support continued momentum into H2.

companiesToWatch.name: Coinbase Global
companiesToWatch.reason: Trump's $1.4B crypto disclosure validates the crypto-friendly policy environment; potential Clarity Act passage adds a regulatory tailwind for the largest US exchange.

companiesToWatch.name: ExxonMobil
companiesToWatch.reason: Strait of Hormuz ceasefire fragility keeps oil supply risk in focus; Brent at $72 carries asymmetric upside if Iran talks collapse again.

companiesToWatch.name: Trump Media & Technology
companiesToWatch.reason: Trump's $1.4B+ crypto income disclosure draws intensified conflict-of-interest scrutiny while Trump Media itself posted a $405M crypto-related loss; Supreme Court immigration setback adds political headwind.

companiesToWatch.name: SpaceX
companiesToWatch.reason: Passive fund buying window for Nasdaq-100 inclusion opens after July 6's close; mechanical inflows expected as index trackers rebalance before the July 7 official entry.

companiesToWatch.name: Alphabet
companiesToWatch.reason: A primary target of Trump's 100% digital services tax tariff threat aimed at Europe; in only its third session as a Dow component, trade escalation risk complicates the AI-driven rerating.
